children: Chiliz brings native multichain Fan Tokens to Base and Solana. The tokens share one native supply across both networks and Chiliz Chain. Users can move their Fan Tokens between the three networks through Chiliz Bridge without using wrapped copies.
The CHZ ecosystem can reach more people by making Fan Tokens available on networks they already use. The change does not affect what users need CHZ for.
FAN TOKEN® digital assets are no longer tied to one chain.
One supply, available natively across CHILIZ® Chain,
. No wrapped copies, no fragmented liquidity.

title: Chiliz: Fan Tokens share one native supply across three chains - 21 Nov 2026
